segment.time: Day, soft natural daylight from the tall windows
segment.first_state: The master camera is on the near side of the one glass-and-gold coffee table and faces the back wall. Floor-to-ceiling windows with sheer white curtains run along the left wall at frame left. The only entrance, an open rectangular doorway, is in the right wall at frame right. The one white tufted sofa stands against the back wall and faces camera. Directly behind it is an arched alcove holding the marble fireplace and the framed painting; the alcove is not a doorway. One potted fiddle-leaf fig stands on each side of the arch. George sits on the sofa's left end and Lauren sits on the sofa's right end. Both face camera, and their hands rest apart and still on their knees and lap. The two cream armchairs face each other in the foreground, front-left and front-right, with the coffee table between them in front of the sofa. Natalie sits in the front-left armchair, angled toward the sofa, in her blue cardigan, white T-shirt and jeans. Her brown canvas shoulder bag hangs from her shoulder at her side, and her hands rest apart on her knees. The front-right armchair is empty. One flat, uncrumpled hospital statement lies on the coffee table at the end nearest Natalie.

shots.camera: Close-up, high angle over Natalie's shoulder on the near side, slow push in from her shoulder onto the coffee table. The camera looks down at the glass tabletop, so behind the statement there is only the glass and the ivory rug under it; the sofa lies above frame.
shots.visual: Natalie leans forward in the front-left armchair and looks down at the single hospital statement lying flat on the glass-and-gold coffee table. Her hands rest on her knees out of frame.

shots.camera: Wide shot, eye-level, slow push in from the near side of the coffee table toward the sofa, facing the back wall. Behind the sofa are the arched fireplace alcove, the framed painting and the two potted figs. Natalie's front-left armchair is in the foreground at frame left.
shots.visual: Natalie sits in the front-left armchair and leans toward the coffee table, her bag hanging from her shoulder. George sits on the left end of the white sofa and Lauren on its right end, both facing camera in the background.
shots.audio: Dialogue (Natalie, in English, hesitant and pleading): {Hey, Dad can I borrow $50,000?}

shots.camera: Medium shot, eye-level, locked-off from the near side beside the empty front-right armchair, aimed toward the front-left armchair. Natalie is in three-quarter profile in the foreground. Behind her is the sofa's left end with George seated out of focus, and the edge of the left-wall windows. The frame stops short of the sofa's right half, so Lauren lies beyond frame right.
shots.visual: Natalie leans forward in the front-left armchair, her hands resting apart on her knees below frame. She looks across the coffee table at her father with glassy eyes. George sits soft-focused on the sofa's left end behind her.
shots.audio: Dialogue (Natalie, in English, trembling, earnest): {Mom needs kidney dialysis and we really don't have any money.}

shots.camera: Medium shot, eye-level, handheld from the near side facing the back wall, framed tight on George's chest and face on the sofa's left end. Behind him are the white tufted sofa back and the left edge of the fireplace alcove. The sofa's right end, with Lauren, lies beyond frame right.
shots.visual: George shifts uneasily on the sofa, his hands still on his knees, and glances sideways toward Lauren beside him.
shots.audio: Dialogue (George, in English, hesitant, trailing off): {Natalie, the thing is}

shots.camera: Medium close-up, eye-level, quick push in from the near side facing the back wall on Lauren at the sofa's right end, framed tight on her face and shoulders. Behind her are the sofa back and the potted fig on the right of the arch. The sofa's left end, with George, lies beyond frame left.
shots.visual: Lauren sits upright, her hands still in her lap. She raises one arched brow and looks down toward Natalie's front-left armchair with contempt.
shots.audio: Dialogue (Lauren, in English, cutting, mock outrage): {How shameless of you to come here and beg us for money?}

shots.camera: Close-up, eye-level, locked-off from the near side by the front-right armchair on Natalie's face in three-quarter profile. The camera faces the left wall, so only the sheer-curtained windows are soft behind her and the sofa lies beyond frame right.
shots.visual: Natalie nods quickly toward the sofa and swallows. Her eyes are glassy but no tears fall.
shots.audio: Dialogue (Natalie, in English, urgent, earnest): {I'll pay you guys back, I promise.}

shots.camera: Medium shot, two-shot, eye-level, locked-off from the near side facing the back wall on the sofa, George on frame left and Lauren on frame right, both facing camera. Behind them are the arched fireplace alcove and the framed painting. Natalie's armchair lies below and beyond frame left.
shots.visual: George turns his head toward Lauren and nods timidly toward Natalie's armchair, his hands still on his knees. Lauren sits upright beside him.
shots.audio: Dialogue (George, in English, placating, soft): {Lauren, maybe we can let her borrow the money.}

shots.camera: Medium shot, eye-level, slight pan from the near side facing the back wall, ending tight on Lauren's chest and face at the sofa's right end. Behind her are the sofa back, the right side of the back wall and the potted fig. The sofa's left end, with George, lies beyond frame left.
shots.visual: Lauren's jaw tightens. She turns her face slowly toward George, her red lips pressed thin, her hands still in her lap.
shots.audio: Dialogue (George, in English, mumbling): {I mean, it's her mother that's sick.}

shots.camera: Medium close-up, low angle, locked-off from the near side facing the back wall on Lauren, framed on her face and shoulders. Behind her are the upper back wall and the edge of the framed painting. The sofa's left end, with George, lies beyond frame left.
shots.visual: Lauren narrows her grey-green eyes and leans toward George at her side.
shots.audio: Dialogue (Lauren, in English, jealous, sharp): {You're still thinking about your ex-wife?}

shots.camera: Medium shot, eye-level, quick handheld from the near side facing the back wall, framed tight on George's chest and face. Behind him are the sofa back and the marble mantel at the left of the alcove. The sofa's right end, with Lauren, lies beyond frame right.
shots.visual: George shakes his head fast and leans back away from Lauren, his hands still on his knees.

shots.camera: Medium shot, two-shot, eye-level, locked-off from the near side facing the back wall, angled slightly from frame right. Lauren is in the foreground at the sofa's right end and George beside her at frame left. Behind them are the arched fireplace alcove and the framed painting.
shots.visual: Lauren leans close to George and stares him down with a cold, fixed gaze, her hands resting still in her lap. George shrinks back on the sofa's left end.
shots.audio: Dialogue (Lauren, in English, cold, clipped): {Do I need to remind you this is your family now?}

shots.camera: Medium shot, high angle from the near side looking down on George at the sofa's left end, slow push in, framed on his chest and face. Behind him are only the sofa cushion and the ivory rug. The sofa's right end, with Lauren, lies beyond frame right.
shots.visual: George lowers his eyes to the ivory rug and his shoulders sag. His hands lie still on his knees.
shots.audio: Dialogue (Lauren, in English, icy, final): {George, without me you'd have nothing.}

segment.light_audio: Soft natural daylight comes through the sheer white curtains of the windows on the left wall at frame left and gives warm side light on the seating. The crystal chandelier is unlit and faint warm wall sconces glow. Live sound is the quiet hum of a large room and fabric rustling on the sofa.

must_hit: Natalie, in the front-left armchair, asks George and Lauren on the sofa to borrow money, with the hospital statement on the coffee table
George timidly suggests lending the money and Lauren shuts him down with a cold stare
George drops his eyes and sags after Lauren says he'd have nothing without her
segment.exit_state: The camera stays on the near side of the coffee table, facing the back wall, with the windows at frame left and the right-wall doorway at frame right. Natalie sits in the front-left armchair, angled toward the sofa, eyes downcast and glassy but without tears. Her bag hangs from her shoulder and her hands rest apart on her knees. The front-right armchair is empty. George sits slumped on the sofa's left end, facing camera, hands still on his knees. Lauren sits upright on the sofa's right end, facing camera, hands resting still in her lap. The one flat hospital statement lies on the coffee table at the end nearest Natalie.
